item.title: Fight Network Partners with the Team Arm Wrestling Federation as Exclusive Broadcaster of the Inaugural 2026 Season
item.description: TORONTO (January 15, 2026) – Fight Network, a subsidiary of Anthem Sports & Entertainment, Inc. and a division of Anthem Sports Group, announced today an agreement with Team Arm Wrestling Federation (TAWF)—becoming the exclusive broadcaster of the organization’s 2026 season. item.title: TNA Wrestling Signs Elayna Black
item.description: Elayna Black, one of the most exciting rising stars in professional wrestling, has signed with TNA Wrestling. item.title: TNA Wrestling Makes Long-Awaited Return to Cleveland, Ohio & Syracuse, New York
item.description: The stars of TNA Wrestling return to Cleveland, Ohio, for the first time since 2013 with the Rebellion showcase event on Saturday, April 11, airing live around the world on pay-per-view. Rebellion will be held at the Wolstein Center at Cleveland State University, a venue that has hosted NCAA Division I basketball games and countless major events. item.title: TNA Wrestling and Eurosport India Announce New Multi-Year Agreement
item.description: Mumbai (March 18, 2026) – Anthem Sports & Entertainment, Inc., a global multi-platform media company, announced today that TNA Wrestling and Warner Bros. Discovery’s (WBD) premium sports channel Eurosport India have entered into a new multi-year exclusive programming agreement.
